interpretation: Agent phases include their own tool/build/native waits; raw phase report times preserved.
Inter-stage time includes operator collection, independent grading, queues and waiting for peers; it is not agent active work.
Native command durations are per-arm/platform sums and overlap across arms; do not add them into a claimed elapsed speedup.
Initial infrastructure setup/repairs and superseded captures are separate engineering costs, not measured v2 benefits.
No calibrated model/hardware/random-seed timing control; descriptive only.

documentedScopeSummary.fullRequirementRollup: unavailable; known exclusion bounds supplied separately

coverageScopeAudit.meaning: Upper bounds only, not fully verified pass counts; no original grades/detection/repair credit changed.

limits: One task, one run per arm, correlated platforms; descriptive, no causal or statistical generalization.
Common improved native observers available in all arms; observer gains are not a v2-only advantage.
Shared hardware/cache and unmeasured service/model seeds; timings are descriptive.
Source checks are separate from runtime case-rule counts; unavailable evidence is not a pass.
Android semantic activation is not physical OS touch; iOS runtime26.5 does not prove runtime14 compatibility.
